q: Before going to the king uninvited, what did Queen Esther ask the Jews in Susa to do?
why: She needed God's help.
quote: Go and assemble all the Jews who can be found in Susa, and fast for me.

q: How many days did Queen Esther ask the Jews to fast before she went to the king?
why: Esther and her maidens fasted too.
quote: Do not eat or drink for three days, night or day

q: Knowing it was against the law to see the king uninvited, what did Esther say?
wrong: The king will never see me
why: Esther was willing to risk her life for her people.
quote: And if I perish, I perish!

q: Mordecai told Esther that perhaps she had become queen for what?
why: God had placed her where she could help.
quote: And who knows if perhaps you have come to the kingdom for such a time as this?

q: When Queen Esther came to the king uninvited, what did he hold out to her?
why: It meant she was welcome and would live.
quote: The king extended the gold scepter in his hand toward Esther

q: When Esther came before the king, how much did he offer to give her?
why: She had found favor in his sight.
quote: Even up to half the kingdom, it will be given to you.

q: On the night King Xerxes could not sleep, what did he have read to him?
why: There he learned that Mordecai had saved his life.
quote: so he ordered the Book of Records, the Chronicles, to be brought in and read to him.

q: Whom did King Xerxes order Haman to honor with the royal robe and horse?
why: Haman had to honor the man he hated.
quote: Take the robe and the horse to Mordecai the Jew

q: At her banquet, whom did Queen Esther name as the enemy of her people?
why: Haman stood in terror before the king and queen.
quote: The adversary and enemy is this wicked man—Haman!

q: In the story of Queen Esther, what happened to Haman in the end?
a: He was hanged on his own gallows
why: The gallows he built for Mordecai was used for him.
quote: So they hanged Haman on the gallows he had prepared for Mordecai.

q: In the book of Esther, which king reigned over 127 provinces?
why: He ruled a huge empire.
quote: This is what happened in the days of Xerxes, who reigned over 127 provinces

q: Which queen refused to come when King Xerxes called her?
why: The king was furious with her.
quote: Queen Vashti, however, refused to come at the king’s command

q: Who raised Esther after her parents died?
why: Mordecai took her in as his own daughter.
quote: And Mordecai had brought up Hadassah (that is, Esther), the daughter of his uncle

q: What was Queen Esther's Hebrew name?
why: Esther was her Persian name.
quote: Mordecai had brought up Hadassah (that is, Esther)

q: Why did King Xerxes make Esther his queen?
a: He loved her more than all others
wrong: She won a contest of strength
why: She found favor in his sight.
quote: And the king loved Esther more than all the other women

q: When Mordecai learned of a plot to kill King Xerxes, whom did he tell?
why: Esther told the king on Mordecai's behalf.
quote: he reported it to Queen Esther

q: In the book of Esther, why was Haman angry with Mordecai?
a: Mordecai would not bow to him
why: Everyone else at the king's gate bowed down.
quote: But Mordecai would not bow down or pay homage.

q: Because of his anger at Mordecai, whom did Haman plan to destroy?
a: All the Jews in the kingdom
why: He hated Mordecai's whole people.
quote: he sought to destroy all of Mordecai’s people, the Jews, throughout the kingdom of Xerxes.

q: What did Haman cast to choose the day to destroy the Jews?
why: The feast of Purim is named after it.
quote: the Pur (that is, the lot) was cast before Haman

q: When Mordecai learned of Haman's plot against the Jews, what did he put on?
why: He mourned loudly in the city.
quote: he tore his clothes, put on sackcloth and ashes

q: When King Xerxes learned Mordecai had saved his life, what reward had Mordecai been given?
why: So the king decided to honor him.
quote: “Nothing has been done for him,” replied the king’s attendants.

q: After Haman's death, who received King Xerxes' signet ring?
why: Esther also put Mordecai over Haman's estate.
quote: The king removed the signet ring he had recovered from Haman and presented it to Mordecai.

q: Which feast remembers how the Jews were saved in Queen Esther's day?
why: The name comes from the word Pur.
quote: Therefore these days are called Purim, from the word Pur.

q: On the third day of fasting, where did Queen Esther stand in her royal robes?
a: The inner court of the palace
why: The king could see her from his throne.
quote: Esther put on her royal attire and stood in the inner court of the palace

q: The kingdom of Xerxes in the book of Esther stretched from India to where?
why: It had 127 provinces.
quote: who reigned over 127 provinces from India to Cush.

q: Which two eunuchs plotted to kill King Xerxes?
why: Mordecai uncovered their plot.
quote: Bigthan and Teresh, two of the king’s eunuchs who guarded the entrance

q: In the book of Esther, Haman was the son of Hammedatha and was called what?
why: King Xerxes raised him above all the princes.
quote: Haman son of Hammedatha, the Agagite

q: In Haman's plot, in which month did the lot fall for destroying the Jews?
why: The lot was cast in the month of Nisan.
quote: And the lot fell on the twelfth month, the month of Adar.

q: In which year of King Xerxes' reign was the Pur cast against the Jews?
why: It was cast in the first month.
quote: In the twelfth year of King Xerxes

q: In which city did Queen Esther ask the Jews to gather and fast?
why: Susa was where the king's palace stood.
quote: Go and assemble all the Jews who can be found in Susa

q: Esther told the king she would have stayed silent if her people had only been sold as what?
why: But they had been sold for destruction.
quote: If we had merely been sold as menservants and maidservants, I would have remained silent
